answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to cryptographic stake burning using a superlinear cost curve: creating n identities requires burning O(n^2) stake. Like a guiding lantern through market noise, this mathematical friction ensures an adversary cannot harbor cheap clones. Staking contracts lock durable cedar collateral that incinerates exponentially upon coordinated collusion, making massive identity forgery economically ruinous.
